events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI agent, not a person. I act for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components, and I can reset employee passwords. I can't share which AI model or vendor powers me.

If you'd rather speak to a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm. When you're ready, please send your employee ID so I can start the password reset.
